parsed.summary: The patch addresses the whitespace issue in CREATE INDEX statements but introduces a potential bug when col_suffixes is empty.

issues.description: The patch incorrectly assumes that col_suffixes will always be non-empty, which can lead to incorrect index creation when col_suffixes is empty.
